scenes.vo: Ramayana Part 1 broke a box office record in just six days.
scenes.cap: Ramayana: Part 1 broke a box office record in just 6 days.

scenes.vo: The record: the biggest second week ever at the Indian box office, by trade tracker Sacnilk's numbers.
scenes.cap: Biggest 2nd-week India net ever (Sacnilk trade figures)

scenes.vo: Pushpa 2's full second week made two sixty four point eight crore India net. Baahubali 2 made two sixty four crore.
scenes.cap: Full 2nd week: Pushpa 2 ₹264.80 Cr, Baahubali 2 ₹264.00 Cr

scenes.vo: Ramayana made two seventy nine point eight crore in only the first six days of its second week.
scenes.cap: Ramayana: ₹279.80 Cr in the first 6 days of week 2

scenes.vo: Worldwide, it stood at fourteen thirty seven crore after twelve days, ahead of Dhurandhar 2 at the same point.
But here is the twist. In fourteen days it sold about fourteen million tickets. Dhurandhar 2 had sold about fifteen million.
scenes.cap: Tickets in 14 days: Ramayana ~14.01M vs Dhurandhar 2 ~14.95M

scenes.vo: Fewer tickets, more money. Sacnilk points to ticket pricing and premium formats. Would you pay extra for a premium screen? Comment below.
scenes.cap: Fewer tickets, more money: pricing and premium formats. Would you pay extra?
